hero.heading: It works! 🚀
hero.description: This is just a simple layout to confirm that Tailwind, SCSS, JS bundling, and the build process are all working.

devCommands.heading: Dev commands cheat sheet
devCommands.intro: The most common commands you can run in this project:
devCommands.runLocallyDesc: Installs dependencies and starts the dev server with Tailwind, SCSS and JS watch.
devCommands.runLocallyCustomPortDesc: Starts the dev server on a custom port (e.g. 8000).
devCommands.runLocallyLocaleDesc: Starts the dev server with a custom default locale (e.g. en).
devCommands.productionBuildDesc: Builds Tailwind + SCSS + JS, copies static files and adds cache-busting hashes to CSS/JS.
devCommands.buildStaticDesc: Copy HTML and assets from src/ to dist/.
devCommands.buildRevDesc: Rename JS/CSS files with hashes and update references in HTML.
devCommands.noteDist: The built site is always in

tailwind.heading: Tailwind
tailwind.description: Tailwind in this stack uses the tw- prefix and only generates classes that are actually used in your templates and JS. Feel free to customize the setup in tailwind.config.cjs.

scss.heading: SCSS
scss.description: Write your custom styles in src/scss/main.scss. The output is in dist/assets/css/main.css.
